name: Joanne Lim Pei Shan
summary: Front Office Manager with 10 years in 4- and 5-star Singapore hotels, the last four leading a front office team of 15 at a 380-room luxury hotel. Opera PMS super-user (V5 and Opera Cloud), strong in VIP handling, guest recovery, training and upselling. Singapore Permanent Resident; English, Mandarin and conversational Malay.

experience.description: Lead a front office team of 15 at a 5-star, 380-room hotel. Led the Opera V5 to Opera Cloud migration and trained 42 users, lifted upgrade revenue by 18%, raised check-in satisfaction from 86 to 93, own the department budget and roster.

Ran shifts for a team of 20 at a 4-star, 520-room hotel; managed group and airline crew arrivals of up to 250 rooms a day; rebuilt front desk training; ran operations through the quarantine-hotel period.
Supervised shifts of 6-8 guest service agents, complaints, cash floats, shift reports and night audit checks.
Check-in, check-out, reservation amendments and concierge requests in Opera at a 5-star, 240-room resort.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Hospitality Management
Diploma in Hotel and Hospitality Management
